records.title: UniAlign: Scaling Multimodal Alignment within One Unified Model
records.reason: Official full-text PDF was blocked by the publisher endpoint; abstract suggests parameter/compute scaling benefits but does not settle inference memory or latency, so retain as borderline.

records.title: MSAmba: Exploring Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with State Space Models

records.title: Hardware-Efficient SoftMax Architecture With Bit-Wise Exponentiation and Reciprocal Calculation
records.reason: IEEE full paper was not available through the publisher endpoint; institutional abstract establishes a possible Transformer-kernel hardware connection but offers insufficient implementation/accuracy detail for a stronger disposition.

records.title: Potamoi: Accelerating Neural Rendering via a Unified Streaming Architecture
records.reason: Conclusion and evaluation cover a streaming architecture for neural radiance-field rendering and reduced pixel rendering; no language-model inference or serving workload is proposed.

records.title: Unified Reinforcement and Imitation Learning for Vision-Language Models
records.reason: RIL trains smaller VLM students to improve vision-language benchmark quality and states that inference runs at the original student speed without a think phase. This is a plausible multimodal deployment neighbor, retained as borderline: the paper does not measure memory/latency gains against an equal-quality baseline or modify an LLM decoding/serving algorithm, despite its speculative-decoding lineage link.
